correctness.rationale: For any full-dimensional integral lattice polygon Pick/Ehrhart gives h*=1+(I+B−3)t+It². Width≥3 and published hollow planar flatness force I≥1. Direct discriminant Δ=(I+B−3)²−4I has Δ≤0 only at (I,B)=(1,3),(2,3),(3,3),(4,3),(1,4). The published isominwidth w²≤8A/3 excludes (1,3),(2,3),(1,4). Remaining primitive-edge triangles have normalized area 7 or 9 and Hermite forms T_(D,a). Reconstructed gcd constraints give exactly D=7 a=2,3,4,5,6 and D=9 a=2,5,8. Independent bounded primitive direction enumeration gives widths 2,3,2,3,2 and 2,2,2 respectively; a=3,5 at D7 are affinely unimodularly equivalent via determinant −1 matrix. Thus only width-three nonreal-rooted class is conv((0,0),(1,0),(3,7)), with h*=1+3t+3t²; at width≥4 all roots distinct negative. A finite HNF check certifies only these eight residual cases; universal part follows from established flatness/isominwidth inequalities.
